column1: Purpose: See your real Revenue, Expenses, Net Profit, and Net Margin for every month, based on actual cash in your accounts.
1. Every number here pulls automatically from the Transactions tab, there's nothing to enter on this tab.
2. Net Profit = Total Revenue - Total Expenses
3. Net Margin = Net Profit ÷ Total Revenue.
3. Transfers between your own accounts are excluded automatically, they don't count as revenue or expense.
4. Update your Transactions tab at least monthly, weekly if you can, so this stays current.
